description: T-2967 probe: which hidden Total and subtotal cells of PIVOTBY (one function over several value columns, column subtotal lines) are computed and make the call #VALUE! on an error. Column A: leaves p/x,p/y,q/x,q/y, 2 values, col_total_depth 2; B: the same at -2; C: p/x,p/y,p/z,q/x at 2; D: p/x,p/y,q/x with 3 values; E: A's layout sorted by value (col_sort_order -3). Each cell: row r holds one record per leaf of a subset, filler row z one per leaf; the LAMBDA is NA() only where TEXTJOIN of the cell's values names the target subtotal (P/Q) or Total (T) cell of row r, value column j. E3 = #VALUE!, a number = ROWS (no error counted).
